title: CrossSection | joined-rims
description: Two views show the same stack. Which image cannot be a plane section? Use the common scale and retain component boundaries.
question: Two views show the same stack. Which image cannot be a plane section? Use the common scale and retain component boundaries.

answer.explanation: Both solids meet in the same disk. A cutting plane gives both the same chord there. The two drawn chords have different endpoints.
